proposed_fixes.title: Peek Monaco WebView2 initialization fails after display/DPI context changes
proposed_fixes.root_cause: WebView2 controller creation may run after the preview host's thread DPI-awareness context becomes invalid following sleep, a display change, or RDP.
plan: Trace controller creation and thread DPI-awareness across preview-handler activation after display transitions.
Initialize in a valid host/thread context or fail gracefully and permit retry after context changes.
Add regression coverage for repeated preview activation after DPI/display transitions.
verification: Repeat the sleep/monitor-change or RDP sequence with a Monaco-previewed file; verify preview recovers without restarting PowerToys.

comment.body: Thanks for providing the exception stack and confirming an RDP reproduction. Could you confirm the exact current PowerToys version and whether `Failed to get thread's DpiAwareness context` still appears after an RDP reconnect? If available, please also say whether a physical monitor/scaling change triggers it without RDP. This distinguishes a general DPI-context lifecycle issue from the remoting path before anyone proposes a controller-lifetime change.
